sources.title: acestep15xlsft-vocals2music · Models
sources.snippet: This model is a template model trained based on ACE-Step-v1.5-XL-sft, capable of generating accompaniment music for acapella vocals. The current version only supports generating accompaniments for audio with stable beats and strong rhythmic characteristics.

sources.title: ACE-Step — diffsynth 2.0.0 documentation
sources.snippet: ACE-Step 1.5 is an open-source music generation model based on DiT architecture, supporting text-to-music, audio cover, repainting and other functionalities, running efficiently on consumer-grade hardware.
